comments: Reservoir computing effectively captures nonlinear dynamics from limited fMRI data, but cross-dataset variability suggests clinical translation requires larger, diverse cohorts.

title: Chaotic photonics in microresonators
task: Review chaotic photonics in microresonators: progress, mechanisms, and opportunities
key_results: Multiple platforms (materials and architectures) demonstrate optical chaos phenomena including wave chaos in asymmetric resonators, chaotic Kerr microcomb dynamics, and cavity optomechanical chaos; opportunities span technological applications and fundamental research
comments: Comprehensive review establishing connections between microcavity photonics and chaotic dynamics; identifies rich opportunity space for leveraging deterministic chaos in optical systems.

task: Enable super-resolved optical frequency measurement using mode-selective atomic Raman quantum memory

comments: Mode-selective quantum memory provides elegant pathway to sublinewidth frequency sensing; integration with quantum networks opens applications in distributed sensing and metrology.
